answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the nebula index resolves every citation against the crystal checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the lantern audit keeps the resolved set. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 48 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
